Pulse 0.8.0

What's new:
- K-line charts now use true candlesticks with aligned volume, mouse-wheel and trackpad zoom, horizontal browsing, and a price scale that follows the visible bars.
- A new intraday K-line group adds 5-minute, 15-minute, 30-minute, and 1-hour resolutions with volume. Click the current resolution to switch to it, or use the compact chevron to choose another.
- US intraday charts can now show pre-market and post-market sessions from 04:00 to 20:00 ET. Extended hours are enabled by default and can be changed in Settings.
- Longbridge minute history now pages backward when needed so early pre-market bars are not lost, while falling back cleanly to the latest page if historical backfill is unavailable.
- Weekly hover cards now show the full trading-week range, chart label spacing and hover performance have been refined, and search opens focused with a simpler prompt.

For first-time installation, download Pulse-0.8.0.dmg and drag Pulse to Applications. The zip asset is used by Sparkle automatic updates.
